svg.aria-label: Brow — Every Claude account’s limits in the notch, workspaces for parallel sessions, and Glim, a pet that eats your limits. Swift · macOS. In the MacBook notch the 5-hour limit reads 54% and the weekly limit 72%; Glim sits beside the 5-hour readout and takes a bite when it goes up to 56%.
